question: How do I change my billing address?
answer: Open Settings, choose Billing, then press Update address and save your new billing address.

contexts.text: Billing addresses can be updated in Settings under Billing by pressing Update address, then saving.

expected_facts: Billing address can be updated in Settings under Billing

question: What is the invoice settlement period?
answer: Invoices are issued on the first day of each month and are due within 30 days.

contexts.text: Invoices are issued monthly on the first day and are payable within 30 days of issue.

question: Can I get a refund after 45 days?
answer: Yes, you can get a full refund within 60 days of purchase.

contexts.text: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase for unused licences.

question: How long does a refund take to arrive?
answer: Refunds are processed within 5 business days and appear on your statement shortly after.

contexts.text: Refunds are processed within 5 business days of approval.

expected_facts: Refunds are processed within 5 business days

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page and follow the emailed reset link.

contexts.text: Password resets start from the Forgot password link on the sign-in page.

expected_facts: Password reset uses the Forgot password link

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
answer: Go to Security, then Two-factor, choose an authenticator app and scan the QR code.

contexts.text: Two-factor authentication is enabled in Security > Two-factor with an authenticator app.

question: Do you support SAML single sign-on?
answer: Yes, SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan.

contexts.text: SAML single sign-on is part of the Enterprise plan; other plans use email login only.

question: Is there a free trial?
answer: There is a 14-day free trial with no credit card required, and it can be extended once.

question: Why do my exports fail with a 500 error?
answer: Large exports time out; split the export into smaller date ranges.

contexts.text: Export failures are usually caused by timeouts on very large date ranges; split into smaller ranges.
